_comment: Copy to profile.json and fill in. profile.json is gitignored.
_email_note: Brokers index records by email. Submit ALL of all_emails on any form that accepts multiple, so records tied to the secondary addresses are purged too. Use confirmation_email for verification links.
_matching_note: Prior addresses and old phone numbers are how brokers INDEX records. Including them raises match rates sharply and is not extra exposure - the broker already holds them; you are helping them find what they have. Aliases matter too: 'Nathan Elijah Jones' appears on Spokeo and Radaris.
